portalsFound.observation: Sindh Board of Revenue offers public cadastral survey maps and records, but its notice expressly prohibits unauthorized reproduction; no openly reusable parcel geometry feed is advertised.
The provincial GIS program reports survey-number maps for 4,000 of 5,979 dehs, so even internal polygon coverage is not complete across Sindh.
Karachi state-land geodatabase project describes 72 of 93 dehs mapped in two districts, not a citywide public parcel service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sindh provincial system with partial survey-number digitization

remainingUncertainty: The public portal may display individual map sheets, but neither Karachi-wide polygon coverage nor reuse rights are established.
nextStep: Seek an expressly open, bounded parcel API or data release from Sindh BOR; test geometry and geographic coverage.
